name: dsh-html-ui
description: Inline HTML + KaTeX renderer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) chats — v4: dsh_html_check model-facing pre-render validation tool with auto-repaired source (repaired_html), optional typed meta header (title/full), bounded same-turn fence repair feedback loop, ruleSet 4 diagnostics with line numbers, lazy rendering, self-contained export with source appendix. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-html-ui

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/validate.mjs && node --check lib/feedback.mjs
scripts.test: node test/feedback.test.mjs && node test/validate.test.mjs && node test/parity.test.mjs && node test/load.test.mjs
